sections.summary: What the feature is and where it applies.

claims.text: Negative keywords in Performance Max prevent your ads from showing for search queries that contain those terms.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: They apply only to Search and Shopping inventory.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Queries that contain an added negative term are excluded from triggering your ads on Search and Shopping inventory, so the control works by excluding traffic rather than by bidding or signals you set.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Because Performance Max automates where ads serve, negative keywords are the documented way to shape search query matching within the inventory they cover.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Whether negative keywords affect Performance Max placements outside Search and Shopping (for example other channels the campaign can serve on) is not stated by Google Ads.

sections.summary: When exclusion is useful, drawn from the documented scope.

claims.text: Use it when queries containing certain terms are draining budget on Search or Shopping inventory and you want them excluded from future matching.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Do not rely on it when your concern is inventory outside Search and Shopping, since the control applies to Search and Shopping inventory only.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Use it when a shared list of unwanted terms should apply account-wide, given the article documents both account-level and campaign-level addition.

sections.summary: The documented path to add and edit negative keywords.

claims.text: Step 1: Go to Keywords within the Campaigns icon.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Step 2: Select the Negative keywords tab.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Step 3: Select the plus button to add negative keywords.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Step 4: Select your Performance Max campaign.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Step 5: Add keywords one per line, or select an existing negative keyword list; a match type can be chosen using the appropriate symbols.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Step 6: Select Save to finish adding your keywords.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: You can choose whether to add negative keywords to all campaigns or a specific Performance Max campaign.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: Editing is documented separately: select the keywords to modify, choose Edit, then Change keyword text, add keywords one per line, and select Apply.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

sections.summary: How to judge the control, with a conditional inference.

claims.text: Search terms report volume containing excluded terms: the causal path is that excluding queries containing your negative terms should reduce queries with those terms triggering your ads, so watch the share of impressions/clicks coming from queries containing excluded terms — but this is conditional, and any impression lost to exclusion is a potential reduction in volume, a real trade-off to monitor.

evidence.source_title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns

claims.text: No vendor uplift figures or benchmark outcomes are stated by Google Ads.

relationships.name: Negative keywords (Pinterest / Search)
relationships.difference: Same negative-keyword idea, but applied to a different platform's search inventory; a Pinterest negative keyword has no effect on Google queries.
relationships.context: Both block ads from searches the advertiser names; the Pinterest feature controls Pinterest search only, while the Google Ads feature controls Google Search and Shopping queries served by Performance Max.

evidence.locator: Target specific keyword match types — 'Negative keywords let you exclude certain search terms from triggering your ads and can be set at the ad group.'

evidence.source_title: Brand safety on Pinterest

relationships.name: Negative keywords (TikTok / Search Ads Campaign)
relationships.difference: Same exclusion purpose on different platforms; the TikTok version is scoped per ad group with a documented 10,000-keyword cap.
relationships.context: Both let advertisers exclude unwanted search queries; the TikTok feature caps the list at 10,000 per ad group, while Google Ads does not state a limit.
